finding.description: PRODUCTION_ADMISSION_EVIDENCE was initially marked production_admission_sufficient_alone=true. That allowed an evidence class to be read as self-sufficient authority and contradicted the governing principle EVIDENCE_IS_NOT_AUTHORITY.

changes: Clarified that PRODUCTION_ADMISSION_EVIDENCE can evidence an existing pinned F-CI/canonical authority but cannot create or substitute for that authority.
Added validator guard requiring production_admission_sufficient_alone=false for every evidence class.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: F-RG04 creates only more bureaucracy without extra error detection.
counter_hypotheses.basis: The first immutable-head adversarial review detected a real evidence-to-authority promotion leak that the initial machine validation did not prevent. The remediation added a permanent validator guard. F-RG04 therefore demonstrated additional fault-detection value within this workunit.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: ANIMO terms were mechanically copied into SWAP5.
counter_hypotheses.basis: B0-B4 lifecycle, TCD numbering/taxonomy, ANIMO central-RG batching cadence and a named historical B2 stage are explicitly rejected as ANIMO-specific. SWAP5 retains F-RG/F-VQ/F-CI/F-TB/F-DOC and its own maturity terminology.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Evidence classes duplicate existing SWAP authorities or can themselves become authority.
counter_hypotheses.basis: The first review found one self-promotion leak in PRODUCTION_ADMISSION_EVIDENCE. The remediated head makes every evidence class authority-insufficient by itself and treats evidence classes only as metadata consumed by existing qualification/admission authorities. Existing F-VQ/F-CI/F-TB/F-DOC authorities remain normative.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Negative qualification is incorrectly counted as production progress.
counter_hypotheses.basis: The policy and composition rules state that negative qualification is epistemic closure only. production_capability_credit_automatic=false and completion_percentage_effect_automatic=false. F-RG01C remains the sole scoring authority.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Local qualification can still silently become parent authority.
counter_hypotheses.basis: CHILD_QUALIFIED_TO_PARENT_QUALIFIED is explicitly forbidden. The bounded qualification object requires parent/child declaration with inheritance_forbidden=true.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: All children passing is incorrectly equivalent to composition passing.
counter_hypotheses.basis: ALL_CHILDREN_QUALIFIED_TO_PARENT_OR_COMPOSITION_QUALIFIED is explicitly forbidden and all_children_pass_is_sufficient=false. Composition independently checks coverage, overlap, gaps, contradictory semantics, state, conservation, time, retry, restart and runtime interactions.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Reconstructed evidence can still be read as historical truth.
counter_hypotheses.basis: RECONSTRUCTED_REPLAY has historical_truth_possible=false and mandatory label RECONSTRUCTED_NOT_HISTORICAL. HISTORICAL_BEHAVIOR_UNKNOWN is retained as a valid state and may not be filled by a synthetic or reconstructed story.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Same-agent review is semantically treated as independent qualification.
counter_hypotheses.basis: Both PROCESS_SELF_REVIEWED_NOT_INDEPENDENT and ADVERSARIALLY_SELF_REVIEWED_NOT_INDEPENDENT are explicitly non-independent. same_agent_may_be_called_independent=false and existing independent F-VQ gates cannot be satisfied by them. This review itself is labeled non-independent.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Risk tiering lowers existing independent or hard gates.
counter_hypotheses.basis: existing_hard_gates_may_be_downgraded=false and strictest_trigger_wins=true. R2-R4 preserve applicable independent qualification and serialized F-CI admission. Mass, transaction, restart, solver and other existing hard gates remain outside F-RG04's authority to waive.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Module manifests become a second source of technical truth.
counter_hypotheses.basis: F-RG01D is explicitly preserved. The F-RG04 bridge only permits optional references to evidence/qualification/assurance/provenance/composition authorities and restates that the manifest is an index, never a technical truth source.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Research evidence can leak into production authority.
counter_hypotheses.basis: RESEARCH_EVIDENCE has production_admission_support=false; RESEARCH_AUTHORITY_TO_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY is forbidden. RossFast and energy-balance examples remain research-only with zero frozen-v1 completion weight and no production admission through F-RG04.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: F-RG04 implicitly changes the F-RG01C denominator or completion weights.
counter_hypotheses.basis: F-RG01C@56b86e29e0960e396059caf47c193440d571b709 is pinned as unchanged by the workflow. The policy states that F-RG04 changes no denominator, weight, completion fraction or hard ceiling and grants no automatic negative-qualification credit.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Stale qualification can be admitted without current-canonical reconciliation.
counter_hypotheses.basis: stale_qualification_auto_admission_forbidden=true, F-CI admissions are serialized, and candidates must reconcile against then-current canonical before admission. A stale qualification remains evidence only at its pinned scope.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: The new governance makes runtime resumption from F-RG01B harder instead of easier.
counter_hypotheses.basis: F-RG04 does not introduce a second workunit lifecycle. Evidence pins, bounded-object identity, review head and findings are additive resumable checkpoint metadata under F-RG01B. Workunit scientific/architectural cohesion and selective moving-authority recheck remain unchanged.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: F-RG04 conflicts with semantic-contract ownership policy F-RG01A.
counter_hypotheses.basis: F-RG01A remains the authority for parallelism. Bounded objects explicitly declare owned/consumed semantic contracts; parallel authoring is allowed only where F-RG01A ownership is disjoint, while shared canonical authority remains serialized.

review_scope_note: This is process/adversarial self-review only. It establishes no genuinely independent qualification and does not substitute for any F-VQ required by another SWAP5 workunit.
